known_information: Issue: ### Microsoft PowerToys version 0.70.0 ### Installation method Microsoft Store ### Running as admin No ### Area(s) with issue? General ### Steps to reproduce PowerToys does not appears in Windows Settings under Apps > Startup Apps or Startup section under Task Manager. Afaik PowerToys starts up with using Task Scheduler, but it should still extend an entry under these two endpoints like it shows entry in PowerToys Settings Page. ### ✔️ Expected Behavior An app entry for PowerToys in Windows Settings > Apps > Startup or Task Manager ### ❌ Actual Behavior No entry appears under the above mentioned points. ### Other Software _No response_
Comment by pneolas: I have the same issue. Automatic start up is listed in the app, but it does not start up, and it is not listed in Window's start up app settings.
inferences: Cause statements beyond issue evidence or inspected source are hypotheses.
